baslik: Seeing a Baby in a Dream
seo_baslik: Seeing a Baby in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing a baby in a dream is interpreted as joy and news in Islamic dream interpretation. Boy, girl, crying baby, giving birth to a baby and the meaning of…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, seeing a baby is generally interpreted as joy, happiness and news. The type of baby, its appearance and what you do with it in your dream change the meaning: a beautiful baby is a sign of good news, an ugly and skinny baby is a sign of bad news or gossip. Dream interpretations are not definitive judgments, but signs and warnings.
icerik:
What does it mean to see a baby in a dream?

The baby is the joy of the household; Therefore, in interpretation sources, seeing a baby in a dream is generally interpreted as joy, happiness and goodness. Baby also means news: the state of the baby also indicates the state of the news that reaches you in your dream. A beautiful baby indicates good news. Since details change the meaning, it is necessary to look at the baby's gender, its appearance and what you did with it in the dream.

Seeing a baby boy in a dream

Seeing a baby boy means receiving good news quickly. It is said that the news will come without delay and will be auspicious. The dreamer may regard this sign as good news; However, it is not a definitive judgment, but a sign that raises expectations.

Seeing a baby girl in a dream

Seeing a baby girl is a sign of relief after the troubles. Seeing yourself holding a baby girl in your arms is interpreted as attaining great blessings, wealth for the poor, and getting rid of troubles. This dream is considered a hopeful sign that a burden that has been carried on the shoulders for a long time will be eased.

Seeing a newborn baby in a dream

Seeing a newborn baby indicates that there will be difficult days for a while, but at the end of these days, good days will come. Seeing a baby being born is interpreted according to the person's situation: it signifies good things for the poor, and returning to the hometown for the traveler. It has also been reported that for rich people and merchants, it is considered as bad, and for men, it is considered as separation from their spouses.

Giving birth to a baby in a dream, giving birth

Giving birth to a baby means gaining new sources of income. For the person who sees that she has given birth and also sees the baby, this dream is a sign of benefit and getting rid of many troubles. Seeing someone else giving birth means achieving the goal. Having a painful and difficult birth is considered a sign of the disease; This is a warning and a reminder to pay attention to health.

Breastfeeding a baby in a dream, seeing a baby sucking milk

Seeing a baby sucking milk indicates the abundance of sustenance and abundance in the house. Seeing a baby you know breastfeeding indicates that the mother of that baby will be happy. Since milk means sustenance and compassion, this dream can also be interpreted as peace in the family.

Loving the baby in a dream, seeing it playing and sleeping

Seeing yourself loving and caressing a baby is a sign of joyful and good news. Seeing the baby playing means that you will be happy, and seeing the baby sleeping means that you will have a good future. Naming the baby indicates that there will be some changes in life.

Seeing a crying baby in a dream

A crying baby is interpreted as sweet words from a loved one. Crying in a dream therefore does not always mean sadness; Sometimes it can indicate a nice word to be heard from someone close to you.

Seeing a thin, fat or ugly baby in your dream

Seeing a thin baby indicates an uneasy period, while seeing a fat baby indicates a good period. An ugly, skinny or skinny baby is a sign of bad news or gossip. Seeing a dirty baby means that you will receive money soon.

Finding an abandoned baby in a dream

Seeing an abandoned baby in the mosque courtyard and holding it in your arms indicates an inheritance that will come through relatives. Finding and taking an abandoned baby is also considered a sign of attaining inheritance in another source.

Rocking a baby cradle in a dream

If an unemployed person sees himself rocking a baby's cradle in a dream, it means that he will soon get a job and will be happy. Seeing him rock the baby in the cradle indicates doing good to his family, and seeing him take it out of the cradle indicates that he is lacking in his duty towards his family. If a sick person sees a baby being given to him, it is attributed to healing.

Seeing a doll, stroller and swaddle in a dream

Seeing a doll is a sign that you will be invited to a nice place; But seeing yourself giving a doll as a gift means doing something you will regret later. If the baby is seen swaddled, it is said that the matter will be resolved soon. Seeing a baby carriage is considered a sign of trouble and financial difficulties; Driving with a child in the stroller indicates a passenger or news coming from afar.

Seeing a dead or dying baby in a dream

Seeing a dying baby signifies unexpected success. Killing a baby indicates that a person will cause great harm to himself. Seeing a baby die at birth is interpreted as despair and devastation. These dreams should not be interpreted with fear, but as a reminder for caution and caution.

According to classical interpretation sources, a baby in a dream

In classical expression sources, baby is considered as joy, happiness and news. A beautiful baby is interpreted as good news, and an ugly and skinny baby is interpreted as bad news or gossip. An abandoned baby means inheritance, rocking a cradle means work, and a suckling baby means abundance. Dream interpretations are not definitive judgments, but signs and warnings; Allah knows the true meaning of the dream.

If you saw this dream

Seeing a baby in a dream is often interpreted as auspicious; However, it is useful to remember the details of the dream and compare them with the titles above. If the dream gives you joy, be thankful; if it makes you anxious, do not rush to judgement. Explaining the dream to a well-intentioned and knowledgeable person prevents the interpretation from being misunderstood.

seo_baslik: Seeing Money in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing money in a dream varies depending on its type in Islamic dream interpretation. Dream meanings of finding money, losing money, counting money, coins…
kisaca: Money in Islamic dream interpretations; It is interpreted according to its type, quantity and what you do with it. Receiving or finding money and silver coins are generally considered to be a sign of luck and good news, losing money is a sign of short-term trouble, and a gold coin is a sign of gossip and jealousy.
icerik:
What does it mean to see money in a dream?

Money does not mean only one thing in a dream; Interpretation varies depending on the type, amount and what you do with it. In the sources of interpretation, money is sometimes referred to as luck, gain and good news, and sometimes as caution in spending, loss or trouble. Therefore, before interpreting the dream, it is necessary to remember whether the money is metal or paper, gold or silver, whether you found it or lost it.

Receiving and giving money and seeing wads of money in dreams

Receiving or giving money or seeing a pile of money is interpreted as good luck and wealth. The dream is not a definitive judgment, but a sign; It is recommended to get tired.

Finding money in a dream

Finding money indicates good luck and abundance. Finding a wallet full of money is interpreted in another way: it is a sign of wanting to earn money without working at all and that this is difficult to achieve.

Losing money in a dream

Losing money is interpreted as short-lived distress and sadness. In the same sources, having to live a simpler life due to loss of money is also mentioned as a meaning of this dream.

Counting money in a dream

Counting money is interpreted as a job that will be more successful than you expected; It can be considered a sign of a process in which you will see the reward of your labor. Seeing yourself squandering money in your dream indicates that you need to be more careful when spending money.

Seeing coins in a dream

The coin dream is twofold. Seeing that you have a lot of coins indicates hostility or trouble with someone, and seeing that you throw away coins indicates getting rid of sadness.

Seeing, receiving and spending coins in a dream

Seeing a coin indicates that you should be careful about a job or spending. Buying a coin is interpreted as a financial loss, while spending it is interpreted as an unexpected gain from a job. Coins belonging to foreign countries indicate that you will receive help from someone you least expect. Seeing that you are collecting old and foreign coins is also a sign of encountering an interesting and unusual event.

Seeing paper money in a dream

Seeing a large number of paper money is interpreted as a sign of financial loss. Seeing that you have deposited money in the bank is also interpreted as a loss. Such dreams can be considered a reminder not to rush into money-related decisions. There are also interpretations that consider a bank dream as a sign that you may lose your job; but these are not definitive, only notable.

Seeing gold, silver and copper coins in a dream

Silver coin is interpreted as good news and happiness, while copper coin is interpreted as good news and auspicious. Gold coin in this dream indicates jealousy, gossip and annoying words. Seeing a silver dirham is also interpreted as obtaining goods. In other words, different forms of the same metal can carry different meanings in dreams.

Seeing a dirham in a dream

The dirhams in the purse are signs of the words you will hear. A good-looking dirham is attributed to happiness in this world and the hereafter, a bad dirham is attributed to being deprived of this happiness, and a healthy dirham is attributed to sound and wise words. Broken dirham indicates hostility with someone or the satisfaction of a need.

Wallet, promissory note and debt in return for money in the dream

Seeing your wallet stolen indicates that one of your relatives will have bad thoughts about you. Signing a promissory note in exchange for money is interpreted as stealing a valuable item. Seeing yourself lending money to someone else is a sign of giving alms and doing charity.

According to classical scholars, money in dreams

According to Ibn Sirin, seeing that you have a lot of coins indicates hostility or trouble with someone, and throwing away the coins indicates getting rid of sadness. Money in other classical expression sources; It has different meanings such as luck, profit, caution in spending and future promises. Therefore, it is necessary not to be satisfied with a single judgment but to look at the details of the dream.

If you saw this dream

Note the type and amount of money and your situation in the dream. Statements are not definitive rulings, but signs and warnings. If the dream seems like a call for attention, you just need to be a little more careful about your expenses and the people you trust in real life. Avoid describing the dream to anyone as a definitive prophecy and prefer the positive interpretation.

seo_baslik: Being Pregnant in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: What does being pregnant in a dream mean in Islamic dream interpretation? Interpretation of woman, single girl, growing belly and seeing someone else pregnant.
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, being pregnant is often interpreted as good news, good luck, and increase in wealth and blessings. Some sources associate pregnancy dreams with distress. The situation of the dreamer, the appearance of the abdomen and the emotion in the dream determine the interpretation.
icerik:
What does it mean to be pregnant in a dream?

Pregnancy is when something grows inside and comes out when the time comes. In interpretation sources, this dream is generally interpreted from this axis: it is interpreted as the fulfillment of a desire, a fortune that will be opened, an increase in wealth and blessings. On the other hand, some sources associate the same dream with distress. Therefore, who the dreamer is, what his belly looks like and what he feels in the dream determine the interpretation. Below you can find each possibility separately.

Seeing yourself pregnant in a dream

If a woman sees herself pregnant, it is considered a sign of receiving good news in classical interpretation sources. This dream also signifies that luck and business will improve, and a desire will come true. The joy and peace you feel in your dream is a detail that supports that the interpretation is positive; If anxiety and distress prevail, the expression should be read carefully.

Single girl being pregnant in a dream

If an unmarried girl sees herself pregnant in a dream, it indicates that she will be a leading figure in the sources. In other words, it means being someone who gets ahead of people and whose words are listened to. This dream does not mean anything that will embarrass the girl; The expression is read as a sign of responsibility and prominence.

Seeing your belly growing in your dream

According to Ibn Sirin, seeing your belly growing like in pregnant women is a sign of worldly wealth and blessings. It is said that the bigger the snow, the more blessings there will be. This interpretation is based on the idea of expansion of sustenance and opportunities rather than the feeling of pregnancy of the person whose belly is growing.

Seeing a pregnant woman in a dream

Seeing a pregnant woman in your dream indicates that you will be happy. The person in front of you may be acquaintance or stranger; The comment is evaluated together with the feeling of relief that the image gives you. For a pregnant woman, this dream is interpreted as good news and the maturation of an expected job.

Seeing someone else pregnant in a dream

Seeing others pregnant signifies good luck in trading resources. If you are a tradesman or business owner, this means shopping revival. It is thought that seeing someone around you pregnant may cause joy for that person; However, there is no definitive provision in the sources for this detail.

Seeing your child pregnant in your dream

According to al-Kirmani, seeing your child who has not yet reached puberty pregnant in a dream is interpreted according to the gender of the child: If the boy is pregnant, it means that his father will receive wealth and blessings. If a girl sees the same dream, it means that her mother will receive wealth and blessings.

Does being pregnant in a dream indicate wealth and sustenance?

This is one of the common aspects of the sources of expression. It is said that the person who sees himself pregnant in his dream will increase his wealth and business. The interpretation regarding the growth of the abdomen is also along the same lines. However, this is not a certainty, but a sign that is interpreted as good; The real giver of sustenance is Allah.

Being pregnant in a dream while being pregnant in reality

According to al-Nabulsi, if the dreamer is actually pregnant, this dream means that she will have a trouble-free period and have a healthy child. It is very natural that concerns during pregnancy are reflected in dreams; For this reason, it is recommended that you do not make the dream a source of anxiety for yourself.

Is being pregnant in a dream a bad sign?

According to al-Nabulsi, the dream of pregnancy is interpreted as bad and means trouble. It is said that the person who sees herself pregnant in her dream will face great trouble and that this trouble will not end easily. In the same source, seeing yourself pregnant also indicates an unhappy married life. As can be seen, there are different interpretations among scholars on this subject; Whether the dream is interpreted as a good thing or a warning depends on the course of the dream and the person's situation.

What a pregnant woman sees in her dream about the child to be born

In the sources, some details seen by a pregnant woman are associated with the child to be born. If a pregnant woman sees herself with a moustache, it is a sign of a boy; If a person who is not pregnant sees the same dream, it means not having children. Seeing a fish coming out of her belly is a sign for a girl, and if she sees herself giving birth to a dragon, it is a sign for an honorable and oratorical boy. Seeing a knife makes a son tired. If she sees that she has a boy, it is considered a sign that the child to be born will be a girl.

Being pregnant in a dream according to classical interpretation sources

In summary, the sources are divided into two directions. Some interpret pregnancy as a blessing, wealth, good news and the fulfillment of desires; Ibn Sirin attributes the growth of the snow to the abundance of blessings. al-Nabulsi, on the other hand, interprets pregnancy in terms of distress and unhappy marriage. This diversity shows that dream interpretation is not a definitive judgment but a sign and warning. The best approach is to evaluate the dream according to the situation you saw, your feelings and your daily situation.

If you saw this dream

Think about what you see in your dreams without fear or hasty judgment. If it is a dream that can be interpreted as good, thank Allah; If it gives you anxiety, do not worry about it, because the expression is a sign, not a decree of fate. It is enough to tell the dream only to someone you trust and understand. Additionally, if there is a pregnancy in real life, it is best to get support from your doctor for your concerns.

baslik: Seeing a Cat in a Dream
seo_baslik: Seeing a Cat in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing a cat in a dream is often interpreted as thief and hostility in Islamic dream interpretation. Meaning of cat scratching, cat killing, cat caressing and…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, a cat is often interpreted as a thief, hostility and disease; It is also given the meaning of servant and compassionate woman. Whether the cat is seen indoors or outdoors, whether it harms you, and what you do to the cat changes the meaning. Killing the cat is a sign of defeating the thief.
icerik:
What does it mean to see a cat in a dream?

Cat is a symbol that cannot fit into a single meaning in dream interpretation. In the sources, it is seen that it is mostly attributed to thieves, hostility, disease and sadness; It is also given the meaning of servant and protection. There are also comments that consider cats as a sign of bad luck. To read the dream correctly, it is necessary to look at what the cat did to you, whether it was at home or outside, and how you responded to it.

A cat entering the house in a dream

Seeing a cat entering your house indicates that a thief will enter the house. Seeing the cat eating the food in the house is considered a sign that the thief will take something from the house. After such a dream, it is a good precaution to be careful about doors and valuables.

Cat scratching and biting in a dream

Seeing a cat biting or scratching someone is considered an omen of a long-lasting illness. If a cat scratches and draws blood or damages the eye, it is attributed to an enemy who does not hide his hostility and opposes it openly. It is said that a male cat scratching or scratching someone indicates that the person will be ill for a long time.

Fighting with a cat in a dream

Seeing yourself fighting with a cat and getting scratched by it is interpreted as a sign of a major illness. This should not be seen as a prophecy, but as a reminder that you need to pay a little more attention to health.

Killing a cat in a dream

Killing a cat is a sign of catching the thief and winning against him. Killing the cat and skinning it means receiving property obtained by theft. Seeing yourself chasing a cat also has a good meaning against bad luck.

Caressing a cat in a dream

Caressing the cat is considered a sign that you attach too much importance to someone who is not qualified. The dream seems to tell you to think again about who you trust and how much you value them.

Cat rubbing in dream

Seeing your cat rubbing against someone indicates that your good intentions will be abused and you may be deceived by flattering people. It is recommended to be wary of sweet-talking and overly close people.

Seeing a mother cat and her kittens in a dream

Seeing the mother cat with her kittens is a sign of anxiety and unrest. If the person who sees this dream has a gnawing anxiety, he should express it and try to resolve it.

Hearing a cat voice in a dream

Hearing a cat meow or moan means talking about unnecessary things or gossiping about someone. It can be understood as a warning to guard your tongue.

Seeing a female cat and a male cat in a dream

A female cat indicates a bad-tempered woman in the sources. Seeing a foreign cat is interpreted as a thief. The scratching of a domestic female cat signifies abundance that will last throughout the year. This dream shows well that the same symbol can carry both warning and good news.

Eating cat meat and selling cats in a dream

Eating cat meat is a sign of stolen property or suspicious earnings. Taking something from the cat's meat or fat is interpreted as gaining benefit from the thief's property. Seeing yourself selling a cat is considered a sign that the person will give alms and contribute from his wealth.

Wearing cat fur in a dream

Wearing cat fur means wanting to marry a bad-tempered, thieving and treacherous woman. Seeing the fur torn, burned or lost is a sign of sadness and distress.

Seeing yourself as a cat in a dream

For the person who sees himself turning into a cat, it indicates resources, making a living from bad deeds, and spending his life with theft and useless things. This dream can be considered an opportunity for you to review the legitimacy of your earnings.

According to classical scholars, a cat in a dream

According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, seeing a cat in a dream has five interpretations: thief, unbeliever, illness, compassionate woman, war and hostility.

According to Ibn Sirin, the cat is a sign of a thief who is capable of mischief. A cat entering the house means a thief entering the house, and killing the cat means killing or neutralizing the thief.

According to al-Kirmani, killing a cat signifies catching the thief and overcoming him; A cat that is killed and skinned is a sign of property obtained by theft.

According to al-Nabulsi, the cat can be attributed to a man who tries to endear himself to the public with words and jokes, or to a woman who is very ambitious in raising her child. Sometimes it signifies an unknown child abandoned on the road.

If you saw this dream

A cat in a dream is mostly a warning: be careful of those around you who might abuse your trust, the safety of your home, and your health. Dream interpretations are signs and warnings, not final judgments. It is always safest to be cautious and cautious.

baslik: Seeing a Dog in a Dream
seo_baslik: Seeing a Dog in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing a dog in a dream is often interpreted as hostility in Islamic dream interpretation. Meaning of dog barking, biting, hunting dog and dog killing.
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, a dog often represents an enemy or a greedy, ill-tempered person. Barking and biting the dog symbolizes words and harm from the enemy, and defeating the dog symbolizes victory. Hunting and shepherd dogs carry auspicious meanings such as sustenance and benefit.
icerik:
What does it mean to see a dog in a dream?

Dog is often associated with hostility in literary sources. It may be attributed to a person who does not shy away from sin, is fond of pleasure, has bad morals, or is a greedy speaker. However, the type of dog in the dream, its color and its attitude towards you determine the meaning; A hunting dog and a stray dog do not refer to the same thing. Therefore, when interpreting the dream, it is necessary to consider whether you are afraid of the dog, whether it approaches you, and what you were doing in the dream. The dream should be read as a warning and sign.

Hearing a dog barking in a dream

Seeing a dog barking indicates that you will hear ugly words from your enemy. Hearing a barking sound is a sign that you are in danger and you need to be careful. Seeing dogs barking indicates that there may be malicious people around you. Seeing dogs barking at people indicates that you need to be very cautious and cool-headed. The howling of the dog is considered a sign of danger.

Dog bite in dream

Seeing a dog biting or scratching you indicates harm from the enemy; The severity of the damage is accepted as much as the pain you feel in your dream. Seeing a dog biting someone else is a sign of illness. Being attacked by a dog also reminds you that you should be careful; In this case, you are advised to be careful about your words and who you trust.

Killing a dog in a dream

Seeing yourself shooting or killing the dog is a sign of defeating the enemy and prevailing over him. On the contrary, seeing that you provoke the dog against someone indicates that you will make a new enemy for yourself.

Your dog running away from you in your dream

Seeing the dog running away from you is a sign that your enemy will shy away from you or move away. The dog leaning on you means that you trust a vile enemy.

Seeing a hunting dog in a dream

The hunting dog indicates a contented, knowledgeable and wise person. Seeing yourself hunting with hunting dogs means halal sustenance, abundant income and security; It is used to achieve fame and reputation. Watching a hunting dog hunting is considered a sign of an irregular life.

Seeing a shepherd dog and greyhound in a dream

Seeing and owning a shepherd dog is a sign of wealth, property and interest. Seeing a greyhound signifies power and victory over the enemy; For a person who is competent to govern, even a high position such as being the governor of a city is attributed. A common house dog indicates a cruel or greedy enemy.

Seeing a puppy in a dream

A puppy is associated with a cute child. It is said that if the cub is white, the child will be a believer, and if it is black, he will be the elder of the family.

Seeing a female dog in a dream

A female dog is a sign of a worthless woman who belongs to a stubborn and bad-tempered community. Seeing a female dog entering your house is similarly interpreted as being related to a vile woman.

Eating dog meat and drinking dog milk in a dream

Eating dog meat means that you will defeat the enemy or eat the enemy's property; In other words, it indicates a low-level civil servant position. Drinking dog's milk indicates great fear and anxiety and enmity with the enemy; In some expressions, it is also interpreted as the property that will come from the hands of a cruel person.

Giving bread to the dog in a dream, playing with the dog

Seeing yourself giving bread to the dog indicates that your sustenance will be abundant. Playing with a dog causes trouble and harm; Talking to a dog means hiding.

Seeing a dog carcass in a dream

Seeing a dog carcass is a sign of illness, sadness, homesickness and trouble. If dog saliva gets on your clothes, you will be fed up with the damage caused by the enemy; If your clothes are torn by a dog, it means your wealth will decrease or a foolish person will backbite you. If a dog urinates on your head, it indicates that your property will be lost and you will be despised.

According to classical scholars, a dog in a dream

According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, there are four interpretations of seeing a dog in a dream: hostility, greedy talker, bad-tempered scholar or servant, and tell-tale people. A dog carcass has three meanings: illness, sadness, homesickness and trouble.

According to al-Nabulsi, seeing yourself killing dogs means defeating your enemies.

If you saw this dream

It is enough to remember how the dog in your dream behaved and review your promise and trust towards the people around you. Expressions are not definitive judgments, but signs that attract attention; It is best to interpret the dream as good and take refuge in Allah. If there is a person or situation associated with the dream, it would be appropriate to act cautiously, fairly and calmly towards him.

seo_baslik: Seeing Water in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing water in a dream is often interpreted as goodness and sustenance in Islamic dream interpretation. The meaning of drinking clear, turbid, hot water…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, water is often interpreted as a good life and good sustenance. Whether the water is clear or cloudy, cold or hot changes the meaning: clear water indicates comfort and goodness, turbid and hot water indicates distress and disease. Well, river and arc water also have different interpretations.
icerik:
What does it mean to see water in a dream?

Water is the essence of life; In dream interpretation, it is often interpreted as a beautiful life and a good livelihood. However, how the water looks is decisive: clear, drinkable water indicates goodness, cloudy or warm water indicates trouble. Therefore, when interpreting the dream, it is necessary to look at the color of the water, its temperature, where it flows and what you do with it.

Seeing clear water in a dream

Seeing yourself sitting on the edge of a spring with clear water is a sign of comfort if you are in trouble, healing if you are sick, and payment of your debt if you are in debt. If you are on a journey, it also means that you can return to your hometown quickly. Seeing that you are taking water from the arc water or that someone is giving it to you indicates that you will obtain goods from a reputable person as much as the water you receive.

Drinking water in a dream

Drinking water means that you will not have money problems and will have a comfortable year. Drinking water from the sea is a sign of attaining knowledge and wisdom in proportion to the amount of water drunk; Drinking sea water has also been described as owning property. If the water is cloudy, it is considered a sign of fear and terror.

Seeing cloudy water in a dream

Seeing muddy water flowing somewhere or drinking muddy water means that the dreamer will get sick. Black or cloudy water coming out of the well you dug is also a sign that you will have a problem. This dream should be read as a warning; It is enough to pay a little more attention to health and daily affairs.

Drinking hot water in a dream

Drinking hot water indicates that you will experience a lot of sadness and trouble. Absorbing water is interpreted as being in financial difficulty. Hot water is not seen as relief in the dream, but as a burden.

Finding water and washing yourself in a dream, searching for water

Seeing yourself finding water and washing yourself is a sign of getting rid of grief and sadness and the things you desire will come true. On the contrary, seeing that you are looking for water and cannot find it indicates that you will face difficulties in the affairs of this world and the hereafter.

Seeing well water in a dream

The water well is attributed to the woman's property. If someone digs a well but no water comes out of the ground, this indicates his desire to marry a poor woman. Al-Kirmani associated the details about the well with the state of the spouse: drinking pleasant-tasting well water indicates forcible confiscation of the spouse's property, drinking cool and sweet well water indicates the goodness that will come from the spouse, drinking hot well water indicates trouble with the spouse's property. Seeing plenty of water in the well means that your spouse is generous, while seeing little water means that your spouse is a bad person.

Seeing river and river water in dreams

The river seen in the dream indicates reaching a great position. Seeing a river whose water has dried up or receded means going on a pilgrimage. Drowning in the river means drowning in blessings, that is, abundance and abundance. However, seeing yourself falling into a big river such as the Nile or Euphrates is considered a sign that death is near; This is not a certainty, but a reminder to take as an example.

Seeing water coming out of the house in the dream means water pipe

If a person sees water coming out of his house, it is interpreted as wealth and goodness. Water pipe means making money and abundance. Preventing water from flowing through the pipe indicates disruption of business and loss, and hearing the sound of a pipe indicates receiving bad news due to lies.

Filling water and seeing a water skin in a dream

Filling an empty container with water is a sign of good things, but filling dirty water is a sign of trouble. Seeing that your water bottle is full and you do not give that water to anyone indicates that you will accumulate wealth but you will not see any good from that wealth. Seeing a basement filled with water is a sign of revealing a secret to someone else.

Seeing a water mill and water closet in a dream

The water mill is a sign of charity, abundance and ease of living. Seeing the water closet spinning indicates a journey, seeing it broken or not rotating indicates financial difficulties.

Washing with warm and hot water in a bath in a dream

Seeing yourself taking a bath with warm water in the bath signifies that things will go well, and seeing yourself taking a bath with hot water signifies receiving good news in a short time. Seeing a cold bath is a sign of trouble. Seeing the dam is also interpreted as spending the earnings on useless things.

According to classical scholars, water in dreams

According to al-Nabulsi, water seen in a dream is interpreted as a good life and good sustenance; Drinking water indicates a comfortable year, drinking cloudy water indicates illness, and drinking hot water indicates much sadness. According to Jabir al-Maghribi, arc water is a sign of a respected person who does good to people. According to Ibn Sirin, seeing a big river is attributed to a great person; The clearer and larger the river, the more respect, piety and rank it increases, the more turbid and small it is, the less it decreases. According to al-Kirmani, the taste, temperature and amount of well water indicate the state of the spouse.

If you saw this dream

Dream interpretations are not definitive judgments, but signs and warnings. If you see the water as clear and pleasant, you can interpret it as a good thing and be thankful; if you see the water as cloudy or warm, you can pay more attention to your health and expenses. Before making an important decision, it is better to consult your mind and the opinions of competent people, not your dreams.

baslik: Seeing the Sea in a Dream
seo_baslik: Seeing the Sea in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing the sea in a dream is considered a sign of power, wealth and prosperity in Islamic dream interpretation. Meaning of wavy sea, swimming in the sea…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, the sea is generally interpreted as good; It is considered a sign of power, wealth, work and the realization of desires. Details such as whether the sea is calm or wavy, swimming, drinking or drowning in the dream change the meaning. These expressions are not definitive rulings, but signs and warnings.
icerik:
What does it mean to see the sea in a dream?

In the sources of expression, the sea reminds us of greatness, power and blessing with its width and depth. Seeing the sea in your dream signifies power, wealth, work and the realization of your desires; In some interpretations, it is considered a sign of rank, dignity and a wise person. The state of the sea and what you do with it in the dream determines the meaning: a clear and calm sea does not say the same thing as a rough sea. Below you can find the most frequently asked forms one by one.

Seeing a blue and calm sea in a dream

A deep blue, vast sea is interpreted as a long road to maturity that will give meaning to life. Sea dreams are generally interpreted as good; In this expression, patience, not haste, comes to the fore.

Seeing wavy sea in a dream

The wavy sea is a sign that success will come after dealing with difficulties. It is said that happiness will be experienced after troubles are overcome. The person who rises with the waves is like the person who seizes an important opportunity and rises suddenly. For a single person, this dream is considered a sign of some problems in his/her heart life.

Swimming in the sea in a dream

It is said that the person who sees himself swimming in the sea will go on successive journeys. Bathing in the sea is considered as cleansing from sins.

Drinking water from the sea in a dream

Seeing yourself drinking water from the sea symbolizes rank and dignity and leading a community. In other words, it is a sign of property, long life, strength, knowledge and decency. Drinking all the water of the sea signifies being an influential, wise and virtuous person, and drinking a little bit of it signifies finding dignity as much as is drunk. If the water tastes bitter or salty, this is considered a sign of being a stingy leader.

Taking water from the sea in a dream

Taking water from the sea is interpreted as a blessing from Allah. Watching the sea to your heart's content is a sign of peace of mind.

Drowning in the sea in a dream

Seeing yourself drowning in the sea is interpreted as having a lot of worldly wealth; Diving into the depths of the sea was considered a sign of being persecuted by the government. Drowning in clear water is attributed to wealth, and leaving the sea without drowning is attributed to piety. Seeing yourself drowning and then coming back to the surface is a sign of being ambitious in worldly affairs.

Walking on the sea in a dream

Walking on the sea and seeing that your feet do not get wet is a sign of being safe from hell fire and worldly affairs will become easier.

Diving into the sea and pulling out pearls in a dream

Seeing yourself diving into the sea and extracting pearls means gaining as much knowledge as the pearls extracted. In other words, taking out a large pearl indicates wealth coming from the state and achieving one's wish. Being distracted and not being able to get anything out of it is tired of trying to learn knowledge and not being able to benefit from it. Retrieving fish, mother-of-pearl or jewels from the sea signifies good fortune and glory.

Fishing in the sea in a dream

Catching fresh and sweet fish in the sea signifies halal sustenance and working in a legitimate way. Throwing a net into the sea or stream and catching fish is a sign of halal goods. The fact that the network is fragmented means that things will become more difficult.

Going on a sea voyage in a dream

Seeing yourself going on a sea voyage is considered a sign that you will achieve your goal. If a person traveling by ferry on the sea sees himself hanged in a dream, this dream is a good sign.

Watching the sea from afar in a dream

Looking at the sea from afar and not going towards it means not being able to achieve what you want. In this expression, approaching the sea and establishing a relationship with it is considered part of the path to goodness.

Seeing a mermaid, a lighthouse and a cloud coming from the sea in a dream

Seeing a mermaid was considered a sign of chasing empty dreams and it was said that one should stay away from them. The constant burning of the lighthouse is interpreted as embarking on an unimaginable adventure; Carrying a burning lantern in your hand is a sign of seizing an opportunity to get rid of troublesome problems. Seeing clouds coming from the sea indicates plunder; Seeing anything related to the Black Sea means encountering a difficult situation.

According to classical scholars, seeing the sea in a dream

According to al-Kirmani, seeing yourself in the sea means being under the obedience of a wise and virtuous person; Standing confused in the middle of the sea means that your job is at risk; Getting out of the sea is a sign of getting rid of sadness.

If you saw this dream

Most sea dreams are interpreted as good; However, these are not final judgments, but signs and warnings. It is best to interpret the dream as good and review the intentions and actions after the dream. You can remember the details of the dream you had and compare it with the titles above.

seo_baslik: Seeing Fire in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing fire in a dream is interpreted as a good thing or a warning, depending on the situation in Islamic dream interpretation. The meaning of warming up in…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, fire is considered both good news and warning, depending on the situation. Benefiting from fire, keeping warm and benefiting from its light is mostly good; Burning, fire and sparks are interpreted as trouble, discord or bad words. It's what the fire does to you that determines the meaning.
icerik:
What does it mean to see fire in a dream?

Fire both illuminates and burns; It is also a two-faced symbol in dream interpretation. In the sources, it is sometimes interpreted as good news and abundance, sometimes as war, fear, imprisonment, harm and sin. Interpretation varies depending on where the fire burns, what it does to you, and whether you benefit from it.

Benefiting from fire, getting warm from it, or doing something with it is often considered good. A fire that burns you, surrounds you, or suffocates you with its smoke is considered a warning.

Warming up by fire in a dream

Seeing yourself warming up by the fire in winter is interpreted as wealth. Seeing yourself using fire somewhere is also a sign of easy sustenance. Seeing yourself warming a cold person with fire signifies goodness and kindness. In some sources, warming up over a fire is also interpreted as engaging in dangerous activities.

Being burned by fire in a dream, being harmed by fire

Being harmed by fire is considered a sin, and seeing fire falling inside you is considered a sign of trouble. Seeing the fire burning your body is interpreted as experiencing distress equal to the amount burned. A fire that has no light and only burns may cause more severe damage; A luminous fire reminds us that the situation can turn out to be good.

In the dream, the fire does not burn, going in and out of the fire

Seeing that the fire does not hurt you is a sign of getting closer to your goal and solving the difficulty in work. Entering the fire and coming out with nothing is a sign of prosperity and Allah's forgiveness. If someone throws you into the fire but the fire does not burn you, it is said that an injustice from a powerful person in the region will soon end and you will be heralded with good news. In some expressions, jumping over the fire is considered a sign of entering Heaven.

Seeing embers of fire in a dream

Seeing the fire turn into embers indicates that the desired goal will be achieved and quick sustenance will come. In another source, firewood indicates seeking knowledge. Seeing a flaming fire burning in your hand indicates that you will receive wealth and sustenance from the state or someone in authority.

Seeing sparks in a dream

Seeing a spark is interpreted as hearing bad words. Seeing sparks splashing over you indicates a violent trouble or love, and seeing sparks flying among a group of people indicates hostility and fighting among those people.

Cooking food with fire, frying meat in a dream

It is nice to see that you are cooking something with fire, it is interpreted as useful conversations and good news. Roasting meat over the fire is considered a sign of backbiting; Therefore, it would be appropriate to pay attention to the language after such a dream.

Lighting a fire in a dream, showing the way

Seeing that you light a fire to guide someone in the dark indicates progress in knowledge and wisdom and virtue. Seeing yourself finding your way thanks to a bright fire is a sign of asceticism. The fire lit on top of the mountain is also attributed to closeness to Allah. According to some sources, fire also indicates wanting and desiring knowledge.

Seeing fire in the house in a dream, fire falling on the house

Seeing a fire falling in the house is considered a sign of abundance. Seeing yourself setting fire to the doors of people's houses signifies victory against the enemy. On the other hand, it has been said that if a blazing fire falls on the door of the house and surrounds your body, but there is no fear in your heart, it indicates weakness against diseases; This is considered a warning, not a final judgment.

Seeing fire in a dream, fire rising to the sky

Seeing a fire breaking out somewhere, if it is humming and loud, signifies war. The fire flaming and rising towards the sky is a sign of the sins committed, and seeing the wood burning in a big fire is a sign of discord and war in that region. The fire burning the trees is attributed to the death of a valuable person. A fire around which people gather means abundance and collective joy.

Seeing a firefly in a dream

Firefly indicates soon-coming joy and improvement in health. The same dream is also interpreted as heralding a short-lived joy or a temporary grief. Seeing yourself holding it in your hand is interpreted as the realization of your hopes and desires.

Worshiping fire in a dream, fire coming out of the mouth

Seeing yourself worshiping fire is interpreted as helping those who betray the state and country; If the fire he worships is very intense, it indicates forbidden property. Seeing fire coming out of your mouth indicates lies and slander, and seeing the heat of the fire reaching you indicates someone backbiting you. Seeing fire surrounding you means obtaining illicit goods due to the amount of fire, while smoky fire means trouble because of haram.

According to classical scholars, fire in dreams

According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, seeing fire has many interpretations: discord, weapons, corruption, fatigue, hostility, ugly words, the anger of the judge, punishment, discord, deadlock, knowledge and wisdom, the way to guidance and calamity are among them. So the same symbol can be both a warning and a no.

According to Ibn Sirin, the place where the fire is lit is interpreted as the place where everyone comes and goes. Going to a place where a fire is lit and seeing that something is given to you there indicates that you will experience humiliation equal to the amount given, and eventually get rid of evil and regret what you did in the past.

If you saw this dream

Instead of interpreting a fire dream by looking at a single scene, think about whether the fire burns, whether it gives light, and how it makes you feel. Expressions are signs and warnings, not final judgments; It is recommended to interpret the dream as good. If you are not comfortable, you can meet the day with a good deed and prayer.

seo_baslik: What does it mean to fly in a dream? Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Flying in a dream is interpreted as a journey and a change of state in Islamic dream interpretation. With wings, without wings, the meaning of flying into the…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretation, flying is often interpreted as travel, pilgrimage and change of situation. Where you fly, whether you have wings, and whether you return changes the meaning; In some sources, flying and disappearing is considered a warning.
icerik:
What does it mean to fly in a dream?

Flying is an action that takes a person from one place to another; In its sources of expression, it is often attributed to change of place, journey and change of state. According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, flying in a dream has five meanings: journey, pilgrimage, greatness, change in situation, illness or death. Which one is meant depends on where and how you fly.

Flying from one place to another in a dream

Seeing yourself flying from one place to another like a bird is a sign of a journey; It is said that the higher you rise in the dream, the more prestige you will gain in waking life. According to al-Kirmani, flying from one place to another is considered a short-distance journey. Flying like pigeons is considered a sign of sovereignty and honor.

Flying without wings in a dream

According to Ibn Sirin, flying without wings means that the person's situation will change. Here, change is not judged from the beginning as good or bad; How the flight went and the feeling left when you wake up determine the interpretation. For someone who flies contentedly, this is considered closer to an auspicious transition.

Flying with wings in a dream, seeing that you have wings

According to Ibn Sirin, flying in the direction of the qibla and returning to the place where you started is a sign of a journey that starts with great profits and ends in a short time; If the same dream is seen with wings, the interpretation is even better. It is also stated in the sources that seeing that you have wings or that you fly with them indicates sadness. According to al-Kirmani, seeing that it has wings but they do not resemble bird wings means getting sick and falling into bed, and eventually getting better.

Flying into the sky in a dream

In the expression attributed to al-Kirmani, flying into the sky with a bridle is a sign of going on pilgrimage. According to another source, flying towards the sky means going on a pilgrimage, and seeing someone flying abroad means returning to the homeland. Rising directly into the sky is considered a sign of harm. Flying non-stop in the sky is also attributed to excessive desires.

Flying and getting lost in a dream, not being able to come back

Flying into the sky, disappearing from sight, and never returning to earth again is mentioned in the sources as a sign of the approaching end of time. Getting lost while flying in the sky is interpreted as death, and flying away from one's own home to a place one has never seen is interpreted as emigration to the afterlife. These expressions are not final judgments, but warnings and reminders; Whatever Allah wishes happens. According to al-Kirmani, seeing yourself flying from your own house to another house is a sign that your death is approaching and therefore you should repent immediately.

Flying from the roof of your house to another roof in your dream

According to Ibn Sirin, seeing yourself flying from the roof of your house to another roof is a sign of divorcing your spouse and marrying someone else. This should be read as a warning, not news: it can be remembered to draw attention to resentments and unfinished conversations within the family.

Flying upside down in a dream

Flying upside down is mentioned in sources as a sign of being unemployed. When a working person sees this dream, instead of worrying, he can take another look at his work order and plans.

A prisoner or student flying in a dream

If a person in prison sees himself flying, it is a sign of being released from prison. If a student sees himself flying, he is tired of learning knowledge. Flying with birds is considered a sign of being together with strangers. The last of the five expressions listed by Ja'far al-Sadiq is illness or death, so the state of the flight and the dreamer's condition should be considered together.

Flying from a beautiful place to a bad place in a dream

Seeing yourself flying from a beautiful place to a bad place signifies wastefulness, and seeing yourself flying from a bad place to a beautiful place signifies being content. The landing place in the dream has been read as a mirror that reflects the person's attitude.

A proud person flying in a dream

If a proud person sees himself flying, this dream is considered invalid, that is, it is not worth interpreting. Seeing the mountain flying is interpreted as attaining sultanate.

According to classical scholars, flying in a dream

The common point of scholars is that flying does not have a single meaning. According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, there are five paths; According to Ibn Sirin, travel and change of situation are prominent; According to al-Kirmani, it has meanings such as pilgrimage, short journey, healing from illness and warning. In short, flying in a source is interpreted as a change of household or job.

If you saw this dream

First, think about how the flight feels: relaxed, high, and peaceful, or fearful and lost? A comfortable flight is often considered a sign of a journey, a new page. If it is a fearful flight, it only draws attention to something you need to be cautious about. Expressions are not precise; Worrying about good and expecting good will protect you from anxiety.

baslik: Seeing a House in a Dream
seo_baslik: Seeing a House in a Dream | Islamic Dream Interpretation
aciklama: Seeing a house in a dream is interpreted as peace and prosperity in Islamic dream interpretation. Beautiful, dark or crumbling house, building a house and…
kisaca: In Islamic dream interpretations, home is interpreted as peace, livelihood and the course of life. The state of the house determines the meaning: a large, clean and spacious house is considered a sign of comfort, a dark and dirty house is considered a sign of distress, and a collapsed house is considered a sign of disaster. According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, there are eight interpretations of seeing a house.
icerik:
What does it mean to see a house in a dream?

Home is the place where a person takes shelter, lives with his family and feels safe. In interpretation sources, the house in a dream is often interpreted as peace, livelihood and the general course of life. The condition of the house is important: a bright, spacious and tidy house provides comfort; A narrow, dark and dirty house is considered a sign of trouble. Therefore, when interpreting the dream, it is necessary to look at how the house looks, what you did there and what happened to the house.

Seeing a beautiful, clean and spacious house in your dream

Seeing that you are in a beautiful, clean and spacious house means that life is as you wish. This dream is considered a sign that the person will live in security throughout his life and enjoy what he does. The width of the house indicates an increase in happiness.

Seeing a dark and dirty house in a dream

Seeing a dark and dirty house means trouble. This dream can be read as a warning urging the person to be careful about issues that disturb his inner peace and to pay attention to the order of his home and his relations with his family.

Owning a dream house

Seeing yourself as the owner of a house in your dream indicates that you will have worry-free days. Seeing a poor house and seeing yourself as its owner indicates that your good thought will bring great success. Seeing a poor house is also a sign of gaining wealth after working hard.

Building a house in a dream

Building a house in a dream means having a pleasant time. Seeing yourself building a house while working on the land is a sign of acquiring goods. Seeing a newly built building indicates unexpected prosperity, and seeing a solid and beautiful building indicates long life. Seeing yourself building a building in a place you don't know means marrying someone you don't know.

Seeing the house collapsed in the dream

Seeing the ceiling or wall of the house collapse is a sign of a disaster in that house. Seeing a collapsed building means neglecting religious duties. After such a dream, it would be appropriate to be careful to maintain peace at home and not to disrupt worship.

Seeing the house growing or shrinking in your dream

Seeing your house growing is considered a sign of blessing and abundance. Seeing that the house is getting smaller is interpreted as financial difficulties. Seeing that there is unrest in the house and that the problems between the family are bothering you is also a sign of discord within the house.

Leaving home in dream

Seeing yourself leaving your home indicates that you will encounter new paths that will determine your future. Seeing that the house is moving somewhere with its walls means that you are tired of moving. It is said that the person who sees himself performing ablution in his own home will be granted a change of home.

Entering a strange house in a dream

Entering a strange house and seeing that you do not recognize the people inside and there are dead people there is interpreted as the place you see being the abode of the afterlife and death is approaching. Seeing yourself leaving the house as soon as you enter it in the same dream is considered a sign of getting sick enough to fall on your death bed and getting better again. Such comments are not definitive judgments, but warnings urging the person to be prepared.

Seeing a house on the mountain in a dream

Seeing a house at the top of the mountain is interpreted as news of rising and becoming superior to everyone else.

Fire falling on the house in the dream

Seeing a fire falling in the house is a sign of abundance. Seeing smoke in front of the house means going on a pilgrimage. If the fire flares up and rises to the sky, it is considered a sign of the sins committed. Seeing that the fever falls on the door of the house but there is no fear in your heart is attributed to being weak against diseases in some interpretations.

Seeing a house made of glass in a dream

Seeing a house made of glass means falling into the trap of your enemies. Such a dream can be a reminder to be a little more cautious towards the people around you.

Throwing phlegm into the house in a dream

Throwing phlegm into the house is a sign of spending money on strangers. This dream reminds the person to be moderate in his spending.

According to classical scholars, seeing a house in a dream

According to Ja'far al-Sadiq, seeing a house has eight meanings: marriage, wealth, security, spaciousness, property, management, dignity and trust. Which one is meant is determined by the condition of the house in the dream and the situation of the person who sees it. In other classical sources of expression, a beautiful and wide house is interpreted as good, while a narrow and dark house is interpreted as trouble.

If you saw this dream

Try to remember the state of the house in your dream, who you saw in it, and how you felt at that time. Dream interpretations are signs and warnings; It is not a definitive verdict. The best way is to interpret the dream as good and try to maintain the peace in your home and continue your prayers.
